sections.quant: Quant carries the most marks in SSC CGL: 25 questions in Tier 1. Arithmetic comes first, then advanced maths. Start with Percentage, because most other topics reuse it.
sections.reasoning: Reasoning has 25 quick-scoring questions in Tier 1. Most are pattern puzzles you can learn in a few days each. Start with the high-importance topics.
sections.english: English has 25 questions in Tier 1. Most come from grammar rules and a word bank, not from reading speed. Start with Error Spotting and the grammar handbook.
sections.ga: General Awareness has 25 questions in Tier 1: static GK, science, history, polity and current affairs. It is the fastest section to attempt, so regular revision pays off.
sections.computer: Computer Knowledge is a qualifying paper in Tier 2. Questions test basics: hardware, software, MS Office, internet and shortcuts. A few days of focused revision covers it.
